steps.name: InitCycle
steps.function: timer(trun := MUL_T_AI(SELF_ACT_PULSE,2 * SELF_ACT_CYCLES), toff := SELF_ACT_TIME, Test := TEST, ARE := ARE, arx := ARX); ARX := timer.ARX; ARO := timer.ARO;

steps.name: SafetyCheckInput
steps.function: INPUT_VALID := (IN >= BYTE#0) AND (IN <= BYTE#255) AND (SENS > BYTE#0) AND (SENS <= BYTE#255); CUMULATIVE_CYCLE_TIME := CUMULATIVE_CYCLE_TIME + CYCLE_TIME;

steps.name: SafetyError
steps.function: out := FALSE; SAFETY_ERROR_FLAG := TRUE; SAFETY_ERROR_CODE := UINT#1001;

steps.name: Branch_0
steps.function: pwgen(PTL := SELF_ACT_PULSE, PTH := SELF_ACT_PULSE); out := pwgen.Q;

steps.name: Step_255
steps.function: pwgen.PTH := (CYCLE_TIME * BYTE_TO_TIME(BAND_B(IN,SENS)) ) / BYTE_TO_TIME(BYTE#255); pwgen.PTL := CYCLE_TIME - pwgen.PTH; pwgen(); out := pwgen.Q;

steps.name: TimeoutSafeStop
steps.function: out := FALSE; TIMEOUT_ERROR_FLAG := TRUE; TIMEOUT_LOG_TIME := CUMULATIVE_CYCLE_TIME; CUMULATIVE_CYCLE_TIME := T#0s;

transitions.guard: INPUT_VALID == TRUE AND aro == FALSE AND in<sens
INPUT_VALID == TRUE AND aro == FALSE AND NOT (in<sens) AND BYTE_TO_USINT(in)>USINT#255-BYTE_TO_USINT(sens)
INPUT_VALID == TRUE AND aro == FALSE AND NOT (in<sens) AND NOT (BYTE_TO_USINT(in)>USINT#255-BYTE_TO_USINT(sens))

Action: Insert a SafetyLog step after SafetyError and TimeoutSafeStop to record the error code and cumulative time before resetting to InitCycle.
